what.text: This page follows refugees from El Salvador living in Spain, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1740 Salvadoran refugees in Spain, 2.6% of all refugees from El Salvador.
The United States hosts the most Salvadoran refugees, followed by Mexico, Italy and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of El Salvador with the FMLN from 1986 to 1991.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2022 to 2025, come long after that conflict ended.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1991 at 17 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Spain.
These are year-end totals for Spain only, reported to UNHCR.
